tabs.label: Settings sections
settings.warning_lead: The settings file had a problem.
general.launch_at_login_hint: Dictate starts in the tray every time you log in, so the shortcut works right away.
general.hotkey_hint: Works in every app. To start and stop dictation from a script, or from a shortcut of your desktop, run: dictate --toggle
general.hotkey_listening_hint: Hold Ctrl, Alt or ⌘/Win and press a key (Shift can be added), or press a function key (F1–F24). Esc cancels.
general.hotkey_portal_hint: Your desktop manages this shortcut. To change it, use your desktop's keyboard settings.
hotkey.taken: That shortcut is already used by another app. Try a different one.
hotkey.invalid: Dictate can't use that shortcut. Use Ctrl, Alt or ⌘/Win with a key, or a function key.
hotkey.wayland_unavailable: Your desktop doesn't offer global shortcuts to apps. Bind a shortcut in your desktop settings to run: dictate --toggle
general.mode.toggle: Press to start / press again to stop
general.mode.hold: Hold the key to talk, release to stop
general.auto_write: Write into the focused text field
general.auto_write_hint: When you finish talking, Dictate fixes mistakes and punctuation and writes the text into the field you were in. With no field focused, a card opens to edit and copy.
speech.engine_api_hint: The service and its key are set under Accounts & API keys.
models.heading: Whisper models
models.selected_missing: The selected model isn't downloaded yet.
models.note.large-v3-turbo-q5_0: Close to Large v3, compressed to need less memory
models.note.medium: A balance of speed and accuracy
models.note.large-v3-turbo: Close to Large v3, much faster
wav.heading: Test with a WAV file
wav.hint: Paste the full path of a WAV file (16-bit or 32-bit float). The model in use above transcribes it.
ai.auto_refine: Edit with AI automatically when dictation stops
ai.summary_model: Summary model (empty = use the main model)
ai.vocabulary_hint: Names, terms, product names… Used by AI editing and summaries, and as a hint for the transcription API.
accounts.key_placeholder_replace: Paste a new key to replace the saved one
accounts.ai_footer: OpenRouter: choose OpenAI-compatible, base URL https://openrouter.ai/api/v1, models like anthropic/claude-haiku-5.5.
accounts.shares_key: Sharing the OpenRouter key from the AI section
accounts.key_optional: OpenRouter can do without its own key when the AI section uses OpenRouter too: it then uses the AI key above.
accounts.footer_openrouter: OpenRouter has no speech-to-text endpoint: the audio goes to a model that can listen (Gemini), which returns the transcript.
accounts.footer_models: Used when the API is chosen in the Speech recognition tab: the file model for files, the dictation model for dictation.
accounts.keys_note: All keys are stored in your system's credential store, never written to files.
panel.caption_toggle: {hotkey} or ↩ to stop · Esc to cancel
panel.caption_hold: Release {hotkey} to stop · Esc to cancel
notice.api_failed: Couldn't re-transcribe with the API ({detail}) — kept the local version.
notice.not_edited_no_key: Not edited by AI — no API key yet
card.accessibility_hint: Grant Accessibility access so Dictate can write into chat boxes.
card.custom_placeholder: Your own request, e.g. rewrite for my boss, polite tone
dictation.no_model: No Whisper model yet — download one in Settings → Speech recognition.
dictation.not_landed: The focused field didn't take the text — edit or copy it here.
dictation.copied_only: Couldn't write into the text field — here it is, already copied.
dictation.copied_elevated: That app runs with more rights than Dictate, so the system blocks the paste — here it is, already copied.
dictation.copied_no_wayland_tool: Pasting on this desktop needs wtype or ydotool, and neither is installed — here it is, already copied.
dictation.not_copied: Couldn't write into the text field or copy the text — copy it from here.
dictation.not_written: The focus is no longer in a text field — here is the text, edit or copy it.
audio.silent: Dictate only hears silence — check that the microphone is allowed and not muted (on Windows: Settings → Privacy → Microphone → let desktop apps use it).
audio.stream: The microphone stopped ({detail}) — what was recorded so far was kept.
audio.denied: Dictate doesn't have Microphone access — turn it on in System Settings → Privacy & Security.
